taskName: Red Team audit and purification of clinical dictation grammar, anesthesia safety advisor, conflict resolution, express 1-click presets and mobile Apple HIG ergonomics
invariantsPreserved: THE_HAMMER Master Prompt (Single-Compiler Lockout, Swarm RAM Guard <=2048 MB)
Mandate 8e (Doctor Autonomy: Primary CTA 'Применить анестезию' is NEVER disabled for secondary fields)
Mandate 8n (Solo Doctor & Scale Sovereignty: No forced nurse disposal paperwork or bureaucratic blocks)
Mandate 8y (Zero Pharmacological Paranoia: Allergies displayed as passive warnings, 1-click confirmation)
Mandate 8f/8am (T.A.R.S. 100% Honesty & Zero-Fabrication: Instrumentally verified by code, tests and PNGs)
Mandate 8x & 8ao (Clean Semantic Domain Language: Removed 'ст. 70 Федерального закона № 323-ФЗ' from diary, pure clinical records, catalog-driven pricing)
Mandate 8ze/8al & Apple HIG (Touch targets >= 44x44px, Natural Thumb Zone, 0px horizontal scroll, 4-state visual proof)

inspectedSubsystems.subsystem: Clinical Dictation Voice Parser & Semantic Extraction
inspectedSubsystems.findings: Eradicated hardcoded prices (priceRub: 850, 1500, 4500, 3500, 4000, 5000) from internal manipulation rules. Refactored into a pure semantic procedure extractor accepting optional priceResolver. Expanded catalog from 7 to 13 canonical dental manipulations (isolation, prep, composites, polishing, endo canal shaping, obturation, hygiene/ultrasound/air-flow, extractions, crowns, implants, RVG, rem-therapy, perio-incision). Verified with 39/39 passing tests (100% scenario accuracy).

inspectedSubsystems.subsystem: Anesthesia Clinical Safety Advisor & Tone of Voice
inspectedSubsystems.findings: Removed screaming uppercase warnings ('ПРЕПАРАТ СОДЕРЖИТ СУЛЬФИТЫ', 'ПРЕВЫШЕНИЕ МАКСИМАЛЬНОЙ СУТОЧНОЙ ДОЗЫ'). Replaced with calm, professional, non-blocking clinical advisories. Fixed annoying false positive warning about missing aspiration check on initial selection.

Cleaned up clinical diary entry formatting: replaced raw statutory citation '(Введено по клиническому решению врача согласно ст. 70 Федерального закона № 323-ФЗ)' with clean clinical record '(Введено по клиническому решению лечащего врача)'. In accordance with Mandate 8x, clinical documentation reflects medical reality without reciting legal statute numbers.

inspectedSubsystems.subsystem: QuickBar Express Presets & Carpule Stepper UI/UX
inspectedSubsystems.findings: Ensured 1-click express presets for daily clinical practice: Ultracain D-S 1:200k, Ultracain D-S Forte 1:100k, Scandonest plain 3% (1.8 ml), and No anesthesia / Intact. Parameterized service pricing via servicePriceRub prop instead of fixed hardcoded ruble constants. Fixed stepper button dark mode rendering clash by assigning semantic bg-[var(--paper)] and border-[var(--line-subtle)] keycaps.

Eliminated orphaned vitest imports in anesthesiaClinicalFastPresetsRedTeam.test.tsx and migrated to native node:test. All 58 web anesthesia tests now run cleanly under Node test runner without requiring synthetic global DOM or heavy Jest/Vitest setups.

visualProofScreenshots.notes: Crisp 1-click express presets, noble teal action, stepper buttons, 0px horizontal overflow.
Pure semantic dark tokens (var(--paper), var(--ink)), passive allergen and cardio badge alerts, zero blinding glare.
Apple HIG touch targets >= 44x44px, Natural Thumb Zone, vertical preset stack, full width primary action.
Dark mode keycap buttons for [-] and [+] stepper with high contrast text, perfect mobile view.
